claim: A limit of 10 SCPs per OU applies to the OUs in an AWS Control Tower landing zone; AWS Organizations states that all policy limits are hard limits.

evidence.quote: A limit of ten (10) SCPs per OU applies to OUs in your AWS Control Tower landing zone.

These numbers apply to only those policies that are directly attached to an OU or an account. Policies that affect an OU or account by inheritance do ***not*** count against these limits. All policy limits are hard limits.
